Conducted usability studies and synthesized user feedback into prioritized UX improvements; created end-to-end flows and clickable prototypes in Figma to align stakeholders and developers. Produced polished UI components and pattern documentation to ensure consistency across products. Employed Prototyping for A/B test hypotheses and used Git to manage design asset versions during cross-functional sprints.
